subject: Quarterly briefing: postpone until post-capex recon?
messages:
From: Miguel Torres <miguel.torres@nrh-health.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@nrh-health.com>
Date: Thu, 5 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Redwood walkthrough this Thursday - request to shift

Vanessa — thanks again for the prep materials. Quick update from our side: CFO is now tied up with an unplanned board review and our FinOps lead is on travel through the end of next week. Procurement is also pushing a short freeze on any new vendor evaluations until the capex recon is complete (they expect that to land early next month).

Given that, would you be open to moving our 45-min technical walkthrough out by 2–3 weeks? We still want to see the runtime and batching examples, but want the decision-makers present. If you can propose 2 alternative windows after Nov 20 that would be great.

Apologies for the late notice — Miguel
Sr. Director, Platform Engineering
North Ridge Health
(attachment: internal-calendar-note.ics)
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: Miguel Torres <miguel.torres@nrh-health.com>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@nrh-health.com>
Date: Thu, 5 Nov 2026 10:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Redwood walkthrough this Thursday - request to shift

Hi Miguel — thanks for the heads-up and totally understand. We can absolutely shift so the CFO and FinOps are available. Two quick asks so we land a date that works for everyone:

- Can you confirm whether the preference is the week of Nov 22 or the week of Nov 29 (we have lighter travel/load the latter)
- Do you want a focused ops + cost-deep-dive (30 mins) followed by Q&A with execs (15 mins), or a single 60-min slot with all content?

I can hold tentative blocks and will share a new invite once you confirm. Attaching the deck and a short mutual action plan so procurement has the items they asked for.

Cheers,
Vanessa Ortiz
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
(attachment: redwood-demo-deck-nrh-q4.pdf, 4 pages)
(attachment: mutual-action-plan-nrh.xlsx, 1 sheet)
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 6 Nov 2026 08:31:00 -0800
Subject: Fwd: Redwood walkthrough this Thursday - request to shift

Team — FYI: North Ridge wants to push the walkthrough out to align with their capex recon (CFO + FinOps availability). They asked for 2 windows after Nov 20. Can we hold the following tentative slots on our side and decide format?

Proposed tentative slots (PST):
- Tue Nov 23, 09:00–10:00
- Wed Nov 24, 13:00–14:00
- Tue Nov 30, 11:00–12:00

Format options:
A) 30m ops/cost deep-dive + 30m exec Q&A (split)
B) 60m single session (full run-through + Q&A)

Karthik — would you be okay to lead the ops/cost segment (quantization/batching/throughput economics)? Laura — can you join for product flow and integration bits? If we choose split, we can do the ops deep-dive earlier in the week and exec Q&A later to accommodate exec schedules.

Also — procurement asked for a signed IP/standards note before the exec session. I have a stub we can attach (short).

Thanks,
Vanessa
From: Miguel Torres <miguel.torres@nrh-health.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@nrh-health.com>
Date: Mon, 9 Nov 2026 15:34:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Redwood walkthrough this Thursday - request to shift

Vanessa — appreciate the fast follow. The team prefers the week of Nov 29; Nov 30 at 11:00 PST works well for CFO availability. For format, let's do option A: 30m ops/cost deep-dive (technical stakeholders) + 30m exec Q&A (CFO + FinOps). Procurement will review the mutual action plan and the IP note — they'll aim to return comments by Nov 25.

Please send updated invites and any short pre-read you'd like execs to see (1–2 slides on cost guarantees and SLA). Looking forward to it.

Best,
Miguel
(Procurement thread: procurement@nrh-health.com)
